The Crossings, Adamstown

Co. Dublin

Applications Closed

  • Starting From

    €1,024

  • Location

    Adamstown, Co. Dublin

  • Bedrooms

    1, 2 & 3 Bed

  • Availability

    248 Units

The Crossings is a new residential and retail development located on Station Road, just a short stroll from Adamstown Train Station and includes a vibrant new retail hub offering a wide range of everyday essentials, dining options, and leisure facilities. Residents benefit from excellent connectivity, with frequent Dublin Bus services including routes C1, C2, L51, and more serving the area. Adamstown Train Station provides direct commuter and intercity rail access, with Dublin City Centre reachable in just 20 minutes. The development also enjoys easy access to the N4, N7, and M50.
